_note: Starting loadouts. RE-RULED 2026-08-27 (gear workbook review), superseding the 2026-08-25 shapes: every class draws from its startPool (the workbook's Start column). WARRIORS AND PALADINS draw TWO HANDS' WORTH — if the first draw is one-handed, draw again (a one-hander or a shield), NEVER THE SAME ITEM TWICE; a two-hander ends the draw. MAGES, PRIESTS AND ROGUES draw ONE weapon regardless of hands. RANGERS draw one bow. Weapons with no start pool exist to be found in game, never rolled at start. ARMOR: every classed hero also draws ONE random tier-0 armor from the armors whose startClasses cover their class (civilians and beasts draw none). Tier-0 armor costs no item slot — a dedicated armor slot exists, exactly one armor per unit. Draws are SPECS — the roll belongs to the draft (named stream), content stays deterministic. heroKits overrides replace the class draw entirely (e.g. the elven ranger will be assigned the Elfbow directly). Audit: R35.

class.warrior.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: two hands' worth — 1H first draw pulls a second 1H or shield, never the same twice.

class.paladin.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: same two-hands'-worth draw as the warrior, from the paladin pool.

class.ranger.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: one weapon from the ranger pool — no special bow rule needed, the pool IS all bows (Longbow included by ruling).

class.rogue.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: one weapon regardless of hands. Daggers (the new pair) included.

class.mage.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: one weapon regardless of hands — the wand, the tome, or a staff.

class.priest.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: one weapon — texts, symbol, or chain.

class.civilian.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: civilians draw no starting weapon and no starting armor. Their gear is dictated per unit (statBlocks kits).

class.beast.why: Ruled 2026-08-27: beasts draw nothing — their weapons are their bodies (natural rows).

heroKits._note: Per-hero overrides — dictated during the Eve differentiation pass, recorded in gen/eve-differentiation.json startingItems and mirrored here as the S12 registry. A hero listed here ignores its class kit. | 2026-08-27, the override grammar ruled with the start-kit rework: a plain ARRAY is a full kit — no randomness, the draw never runs (both elf rangers pin the Elfbow this way). {pinned:[...]} guarantees those items and lets the CLASS DRAW complete the rest — a pinned one-hander on a warrior or paladin still rolls the second hand; a pinned two-hander, or any pin on a one-weapon class, ends it. No entry at all = the plain class draw. One grammar, three cases.

civilianKitsLiveIn: gen/civilian-rulings.json statBlocks — same per-hero principle, dictated with their stat blocks.

armorDraw.rule: one random tier-0 armor per classed hero, from the armors whose startClasses cover the class; civilians and beasts draw none
armorDraw.source: Ruled 2026-08-27. The pools live on the armor rows as startClasses ("any" or a class list).
